newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends shade up in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends shade up in moderate trade.

text.p: * Volume rose to $111.70 million from $96.5 million
The peso ended slightly firmer at 26.220 to a U.S. dollar on Thursday from the previous 26.228 as banks continued to sell the foreign currency, traders said.
"Banks continue to unload dollars which they hoarded in the past few days when overnight rates shot to high levels," one dealer said.
The interbank rate softened to 12.59375 percent from 12.78125 percent as the Central Bank maintained its overnight rates.
The Central Bank had raised its overnight borrowing and lending rates on Tuesday and Wednesday to quell speculation in the foreign exchange market.
The peso hit a high of 26.214 and a low of 26.226, with the weighted average reaching 26.22.
Volume edged up to $111.70 million from the previous $96.5 million. - KATHERINE ESPINA 63 2 841-8937 Fax 8176267
